title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 20 West White Street in Millstadt, Illinois, as the "Corporal Matthew A. Wyatt Post Office".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the U.S. Postal Service located at 20 West White Street in Millstadt, Illinois, as the Corporal Matthew A. Wyatt Post Office.

summary.headline: Names the Postal Service facility at 20 West White Street in Millstadt, Illinois, the Corporal Matthew A. Wyatt Post Office.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames a U.S. Postal Service building in Millstadt, Illinois, after Corporal Matthew A. Wyatt. It changes only the official name of the facility. It does not change mail service, postal rules, or the building's operations.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 4, 2025.
